properties.value: Abstract base concept for all SQL statements in the initial db2sql language model.
Represents an INSERT statement in db2sql. In the current model, this concept identifies an INSERT command as a distinct SQL statement type.
Represents an UPDATE statement in db2sql. In the current model, this concept identifies an UPDATE command as a distinct SQL statement type.
Represents a DELETE statement in db2sql. In the current model, this concept identifies a DELETE command as a distinct SQL statement type.
Represents a CREATE TABLE statement in db2sql. In the current model, this concept identifies a table-creation command as a distinct SQL statement type.
Represents a DROP TABLE statement in db2sql. In the current model, this concept identifies a table-drop command as a distinct SQL statement type.
Represents an ALTER TABLE statement in db2sql. In the current model, this concept identifies a table-alteration command as a distinct SQL statement type.
Represents a COMMIT statement in db2sql. This statement explicitly ends the current transaction and makes the changes performed in the transaction permanent.
Top-level container for a db2sql source file or script. It owns an ordered list of DB2SQLStatement nodes representing the statements that appear in the script.
Abstract base concept for Data Definition Language statements in db2sql, such as CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE, and ALTER TABLE.
Abstract base concept for query statements in db2sql, currently used for SELECT statements.
Abstract base concept for WHERE/HAVING-style search conditions in db2sql. It will represent boolean predicates used to filter rows in SELECT, UPDATE, and DELETE statements.

Abstract base concept for table-producing expressions that can appear in a FROM clause. This covers plain table references, aliased table expressions, parenthesized table expressions, and query-derived tables.
A reference to a table name used as a table-producing expression in a FROM clause.
A table-producing expression with an alias, written as expr AS foo.
A parenthesized table-producing expression, written as ( expr ).
A table-producing expression that wraps a query statement and allows it to appear in a FROM clause as a derived table.
Represents an equality comparison in db2sql, written with the equals operator. It compares the left and right DB2SQLExpression operands for equality.
Represents an inequality comparison in db2sql, written with the not-equals operator. It compares the left and right DB2SQLExpression operands for inequality.
Represents a less-than comparison in db2sql. It compares the left DB2SQLExpression operand to the right operand using the '<' operator.
Represents a less-than-or-equal comparison in db2sql. It compares the left DB2SQLExpression operand to the right operand using the '<=' operator.
Represents a greater-than comparison in db2sql. It compares the left DB2SQLExpression operand to the right operand using the '>' operator.
Represents a greater-than-or-equal comparison in db2sql. It compares the left DB2SQLExpression operand to the right operand using the '>=' operator.
Abstract base concept for literal expressions in db2sql. Literal concepts represent inline constant values used in SQL expressions.
Represents a numeric literal in db2sql. The number is stored as a string property so the original textual form can be preserved.
Abstract base concept for boolean literals in db2sql. It is specialized by concrete true and false literal concepts.
Represents the boolean literal true in db2sql.
Represents the boolean literal false in db2sql.
Represents a string literal in db2sql. The literal text is stored as a string property, including its textual content as parsed.

Abstract base concept for arithmetic expressions in db2sql. It captures binary numeric operations and serves as the parent for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division expressions. This follows DB2 SQL operator precedence, where multiplication and division bind more tightly than addition and subtraction.
Represents an addition operation in db2sql, written with the '+' operator. It has left and right DB2SQLExpression operands inherited from DB2SQLArithmeticExpression.
Represents an subtraction operation in db2sql, written with the '-' operator. It has left and right DB2SQLExpression operands inherited from DB2SQLArithmeticExpression.
Represents a multiplication operation in db2sql, written with the '*' operator. It has left and right DB2SQLExpression operands inherited from DB2SQLArithmeticExpression.
Represents a division operation in db2sql, written with the '/' operator. It has left and right DB2SQLExpression operands inherited from DB2SQLArithmeticExpression.
